precepts.text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: that bitterness is the spirit of Cain, and in that wrathful spirit you might slay a brother. None of us is above this. Do not sit in the congregation thinking such and such is getting cut with the scriptures; brother, that is you. Every lesson the leadership brings out is for us. As soon as you think, I am not dealing with that, Satan already has you lined up.
precepts.point: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: this is the deception. He acted like his friend, talked with him over a period of time, and lured him out to the field. And when they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him. That is the spirit you are rolling in when you move with that bitter spirit; in that wrath you will slay a brother, or in that bitterness you might betray a brother.

note.label: Bitterness: The Hidden Leaven From Cain To Esau

precepts.why:
“Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.” That bitterness is the spirit of Cain, and in that wrath you might slay a brother, or in that bitterness you might betray one. None of us is above this. Do not sit in the congregation thinking so-and-so is getting cut with the scriptures; brother, that is you. Every lesson the leadership brings out is for us. The moment you think, I am not dealing with that, Satan already has you lined up and counts you on his team.

Go back to Genesis 4:8: “And Cain talked with Abel his brother”. This is the deception. Cain acted like his friend, talking with him over time about his flocks, until he could lure him out to the field: “when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.” Solomon describes that man: “He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;” “When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.” Murder, envy, pride and covetousness are all in there. “Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.” That is why it is called a root of bitterness: roots are covered by soil where nobody can see them, but the Lord always brings it to the surface. “Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein”, and “a flattering mouth worketh ruin.”

John names the spirit: “Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother.” Cain was the first recorded hater in the scriptures, and he came back as Esau. The scribes and Pharisees were bitter toward Christ and wanted him dead; carry an evil eye toward your brother and you are in the same spirit. “We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.” “Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer”. And Sirach warns, “When the ungodly curseth Satan, he curseth his own soul.” Brothers say, the white man is the devil, they are going to be destroyed, they are going into captivity, and then carry hatred toward their own brother, moving in the same spirit.

“Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.” Bitterness is a progression: it starts with a correction or an offense, then pride comes in and you will not speak to the brother, then when you do speak it is in deceit, masking envy, anger and hatred, and in the end it destroys you and those around you. “A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump”: a little bitterness defiles the whole soul. Christ said, “Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.” “For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed”. Leaven looks flat at first and grows as it bakes, so do not let the hate bake. Deal with your brother and sister uprightly according to the laws of God before it festers and overcomes you.

precepts.text: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him. They are watching those of us who keep the commandments, so walk right and be an example.
precepts.point: His eyes are privily set against the poor: the eye on the dollar, the surveillance that sees every site you visit and, through the ADL and the police systems, every bank account. He lieth in wait secretly as a lion to catch the poor when he draweth him into his net, and the poor fall by his strong ones, the police and the military.

note.label: Cyber Warfare: The Mouth Of The Beast

precepts.why:
Esau “hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.” The white man's mouth is full of cursing, deceit and fraud. “He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent”: that is Mossad and the CIA, the black sites where they would put us and kill us. And “his eyes are privily set against the poor”: the eye on the back of the dollar bill, and the social media and technology set up to monitor us. Every porn video you watch, every site you go on, the white man knows. The ADL monitors bank accounts, and even the police can see all that information. Everything is coming under one system.

David says it plainly: “The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.” Brothers and sisters, they are watching you. With the system they have set up they can tell everything you are doing. They are watching those of us who keep the commandments, who call ourselves Israelites. They know there are more than a million people in America who identify as Israelites and agree with these teachings.

And they seek to slay him: they want to destroy us. “He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor.” He wants to catch you slipping, clicking on the wrong thing. “He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones”: the government, the police, the military.

So walk right and be an example. Build yourselves up. If the wicked is watching the righteous, let him find nothing on you but the commandments of God.

precepts.point: "Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil." If it has not manifested yet, something is off between your house, yourself and what you do in the body. Realign your desires, then be useful or be cast to the side.

precepts.text: I was envious at the foolish when I saw the prosperity of the wicked, for there are no bands in their death and their strength is firm; pride and violence cover them.
precepts.point: Do not fret because of evildoers nor be envious against the workers of iniquity, for they shall soon be cut down like the grass.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

precepts.why:
“Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.” The psalmist confesses the very thing: “For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.” Read on and he says why it looked so good: there are no bands in their death and their strength is firm; pride and violence cover them.

This chapter hit home. Coming into this truth, David saw where his life was versus where other people's lives were and what they were doing, and it started to mess with his spirit a little. When I first came into the truth I would look at the wicked of our people and of the other nations, with no God and no laws, and they were prospering with a bunch of material things. That is why the scripture says do not fret or be envious of them: “they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.” Reading things like this gave the strength to keep going.

precepts.text: This is the confidence we have in him, that if we ask anything according to his will he hears us; ask according to his will, not to stumble somebody or to boast on social media, but to serve the nation.
precepts.point: Delight thyself in the Most High and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart; commit thy way unto him and he shall bring it to pass.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

precepts.why:
“Delight thyself also in the Lord; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart. Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.” John gives the condition on those desires: “this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us”.

Ask according to his will: not to stumble somebody, not to boast on social media, but to serve the nation. When you delight yourself in the Most High by keeping the commandments and trusting him, he brings it to pass. If you are always doubting, or asking for stuff without believing in him, it is not going to happen. That is why we have to continually meditate in the word day and night.

precepts.text: Ye ask and receive not because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts; do not pray for enemies to fall so you can stunt on them, but so you can continue to do his will uninterrupted.
precepts.point: Delight thyself in the Most High and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart; commit thy way unto him and he shall bring it to pass.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

precepts.why:
“he shall give thee the desires of thine heart”, yet James shows why so many ask and get nothing: “Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.” The desire of the heart has to be according to his will.

So do not pray for your enemies to fall so you can stunt on them; pray that they fall so you can continue to do his will uninterrupted. Commit your way to the Most High by keeping the commandments and trusting him, and “he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.”

precepts.text: The triumphing of the wicked is short and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment; though his excellency mount up to the heavens, he shall perish forever like his own dung and be chased away as a vision of the night.
precepts.point: For yet a little while and the wicked shall not be; you shall diligently consider his place and it shall not be.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

precepts.why:
“For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.” Job says the same: “the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment”. “Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds; Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he? He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.”

These wicked people running this earth are not going to be here forever. A time will come when they are gone for ever, and we will wake up as from a bad dream, hardly believing our slave was ruler over a whole country.

So “Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him”. Everything happens on the Most High's time. You may not get it right now because you are not ready for it. Sisters and brothers may be asking for a husband or wife, but if you are not ready he will make you wait; wait for it and you may come out with a beautiful marriage, but be impatient and you get a back door marriage, because you are not trusting in him. Whenever we do something outside the counsel given by godly men, we are not trusting in the Most High.

“For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.” We put the Most High through drama to give this earth away, so we have to go through some drama to get it back.

precepts.text: In the day of the Lord's sacrifice he will punish the princes and the king's children and all such as are clothed with strange apparel; strange apparel goes against what the Bible says, like women in pants.
precepts.point: But the wicked shall perish and the enemies of the Most High shall be as the fat of lambs; they shall consume into smoke.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

precepts.why:
“But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the Lord shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.” Zephaniah names who is on that list: “it shall come to pass in the day of the Lord’s sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king’s children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.” Strange apparel goes against what the Bible says, like women in pants.

That day is the evil time, and “A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked”, for neither their silver nor their gold is going to save them in it. The righteous “shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.” That is why we have food pantries in our cities: when the days of famine come, the Most High will make sure we are satisfied. All you have to do is get in touch with your leadership in your state, and there is no shame in it.

precepts.text: Do not always be the give-me person who then vanishes when it is time to give back.
precepts.point: The wicked borrows and pays not again, but the righteous shows mercy and gives. That is those people who borrow and then shut their hand when it comes time to pay. That is not the way we are supposed to be as a people.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

precepts.why:
“The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.” Ecclesiasticus puts it plainly: “Let not thine hand be stretched out to receive, and shut when thou shouldest repay.” That is those people who borrow and then shut their hand when it comes time to pay, the give-me person who vanishes when it is time to give back. That is not the way we are supposed to be as a people.

You cannot make it in this captivity alone. Everything we have, we have to share with one another. Black Wall Street is here; the little we have, we try to make sure our brothers and sisters are taken care of. The righteous “is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.”

“I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.” The Most High never saw the righteous begging bread, because we are supposed to have each other; if we have each other we will not be begging bread, and we will be good in times of famine.

Good men, whose steps are ordered by the Most High, are men that keep the commandments. Somebody may say the Bible says none is good, which is true, but you have to fight to be good; Christ says strive to enter in through the straight gate. Wickedness will come and you may fall, but like Proverbs says, a righteous man falls seven times and gets back up again. “Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholdeth him with his hand.” If you fall short of the glory and stay short, that is on you; get back up and reach for the full glory.

precepts.text: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten, he hideth his face, he will never see it; that is why they say it is all in the past, that you are stuck in the Old Testament.
precepts.point: A lot of people, especially the wicked Esau and those Christians, say the Most High has forgotten and hides his face.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

precepts.why:
“For the Lord loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.” The wicked believe the opposite: “He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.” That is why they say it is all in the past, that you are stuck in the Old Testament. A lot of people, especially the wicked Esau and those Christians, say the Most High has forgotten and hides his face.

But the Most High forsakes not his saints. Everything the wicked and their seed have done, they are still going to pay for. Even after Christ we went through slavery and all types of wicked punishments at the hand of our enemies, and he did not forget that they are wicked and that payback is coming to them. “The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever”, with the law of his God in his heart, and none of his steps shall slide.

precepts.text: Lo, the wicked bend their bow and make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
precepts.point: The wicked watches the righteous and seeks to slay him. That goes back to them devising wickedness upon their bed.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

precepts.why:
“The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.” That goes back to them devising wickedness upon their bed. Psalm 11 shows how they go about it: “For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.” They shoot privily, in secret, while they watch.

The wicked are always watching, which is why when we go out in public we are supposed to be the righteous example and let our light shine. Esau will read your Israel United in Christ shirt, your true Jew or Israelite shirt, and study everything, looking for a weak link in the chain to blame everybody. One person could get caught doing wrong and they will say everybody in there is like that and put it on the news. But “The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.”

precepts.text: They whet their tongue like a sword and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words, that they may shoot in secret at the perfect; whet means to sharpen, so they prepare exactly what to say so it can slice just right and catch the attention of the masses.
precepts.point: The wicked watches the righteous and seeks to slay him. That goes back to them devising wickedness upon their bed.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

precepts.why:
The arrows the wicked make ready are words. “Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.” Whet means to sharpen: they prepare exactly what to say so it can slice just right and catch the attention of the masses. “They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?”

This is the wicked watching the righteous and seeking to slay him. They study everything about us, looking for the one weak link, and when they find it they sharpen the words for the news so that everybody gets blamed. So be the righteous example in public. “Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.” As long as we keep the commandments, it is nothing but peace for us in the kingdom to come, “But the transgressors shall be destroyed together”.

precepts.text: Esau is the border of wickedness, the one we are saved from.
precepts.point: The salvation of the righteous is of the Most High; he is their strength in the time of trouble and delivers them from the wicked because they trust in him. That is why salvation is so important: we get saved from the wicked.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

precepts.why:
“But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble. And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.” Who is the wicked we are saved from? “Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” Esau is the border of wickedness, the one we are saved from.

That is why salvation is so important: we get saved from the wicked. “I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree. Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.” That is the destruction of the wicked, and the ones who see the salvation and live through it are going to make it. That is my prayer, that I make it.

precepts.text: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; we have to remember Esau runs the earth.
precepts.point: The salvation of the righteous is of the Most High; he is their strength in the time of trouble and delivers them from the wicked because they trust in him. That is why salvation is so important: we get saved from the wicked.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

precepts.why:
“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?” We have to remember that Esau runs the earth. That is why the wicked can watch the righteous and seek to slay him, and why he is seen “in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.”

But the earth in his hand is not the end of it. “Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.” The Most High will not leave the righteous in the wicked's hand; the wicked passes away and cannot be found, and the righteous inherit the land.

points: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread. That verse will not work if we do not work together. Every Sabbath we point to the donation screen: IUIC is helping a lot of brothers and sisters, especially outside of America. Passover is about to happen, and every school outside America has to hold Passover: they have to get lambs, garments, and rent a hall, and it costs money. That verse comes to pass because we work together to make sure the brothers and sisters have what they need. For that, we have to trust each other and depend on each other.

I am not talking about the brother who was supposed to save food six years ago and said the hell with the bishop's counsel; do not come to my house. Bishop has been teaching this for seven years. If every year you had bought a hundred dollars of groceries and saved it, think how much rice and beans you would have right now. But some of you are not serious. America has spoiled some of you, and I feel sorry for some of you for what is about to happen; you have never seen famine before, so you thought we did not know what we were talking about. Now a bag of rice you cannot even afford, and you have a wife and kids. Some of you cry because they cut your electricity and there is no hot water to shower. Is there cold water? Then you can shower. In the islands many houses have no water heater. Last year in Sierra Leone the captain went two weeks without hot water and showered every day. You have been spoiled, brother.

points: Do good and dwell forevermore, for the Most High loves judgment and forsakes not his saints; they are preserved forever, but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

The Most High forsakes not his saints. Everything the wicked and their seed have done, they are still going to pay for. Just like even after Christ we went through slavery and all types of wicked punishments at the hand of our enemies, he did not forget that they are wicked and that payback is coming to them.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

points: The righteous shall inherit the land and dwell therein forever; the law of his God is in his heart, none of his steps shall slide.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

points: The wicked watches the righteous and seeks to slay him. That goes back to them devising wickedness upon their bed.

The wicked are always watching, which is why when we go out in public we are supposed to be the righteous example and let our light shine. Esau will read your Israel United in Christ shirt, your true Jew or Israelite shirt, and study everything, looking for a weak link in the chain to blame everybody. One person could get caught doing wrong and they will say everybody in there is like that and put it on the news.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

points: The Most High will not leave the righteous in the wicked's hand or condemn him when he is judged; wait on him and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land, and when the wicked are cut off thou shalt see it.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

points: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading like a green bay tree, yet he passed away and was not; I sought him but he could not be found. That is the destruction of the wicked, and the ones who see the salvation and live through it are going to make it. That is my prayer, that I make it.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

points: Mark the perfect man and behold the upright, for the end of that man is peace. As long as we keep the commandments, it is nothing but peace for us in the kingdom to come, but the transgressors shall be destroyed together.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

points: The salvation of the righteous is of the Most High; he is their strength in the time of trouble and delivers them from the wicked because they trust in him. That is why salvation is so important: we get saved from the wicked.
